raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation - Kimi-K2.5 routes with grouped top-k: 8 routed experts plus 1 fused shared expert. - On ROCm/AITER with one expert-parallel rank, the shared expert's ID and weight are appended after grouped top-k by a separate `fused_append_shared_experts` launch in every MoE layer. - That launch sits on the latency-critical decode path and only writes constants, so it can be removed. ## Modifications - New fast path `srt/layers/moe/aiter_topk.py`, tried first by `select_experts` on ROCm/AITER. - One persistent `[height, routed_k + n_shared]` weight/ID buffer per routing config, with the shared columns pre-filled once. AITER `biased_grouped_topk` writes the routed columns through strided views, so no append launch runs. - Buffers live in the runtime context (`get_buffer`): - Height = max(chunked-prefill size, `max_prefill_tokens`), floored at 8192 and capped at 131072 rows. - Cost: `layers x height x (routed_k + n_shared) x 8 B`, e.g. about 71 MB for 60 layers at 16384 rows. - Never allocated inside a CUDA-graph capture; that call takes the ordinary path. - Same kernel inputs as the ordinary path: an fp32 correction bias routes in fp32 (shared helper `aiter_grouped_topk_route_inputs`). - KT's `mask_cpu_expert_ids` now masks out of place, so it cannot overwrite the persistent shared column. - No new env var or flag. Fallbacks (the existing routing + append path runs): | Condition | Reason | |---|---| | Not grouped top-k, no correction bias, or no fused shared expert | nothing to fuse | | `moe_ep_size != 1` or per-rank shared slots (DeepEP/MegaMoE) | shared IDs are per rank | | `num_token_non_padded` or expert-location dispatch set | padding mask / EPLB remap edit `topk_ids` in place | | `SGLANG_SIMULATE_*_EXPERTS`, `SGLANG_OPT_USE_JIT_KERNEL_GROUPED_TOPK` | another router writes the IDs | | `SGLANG_K3_RADIX4_TOPK` and radix4 covers the shape (Kimi-K3) | radix4 routes it | | `TopK.forward_native` (torch.compile bs=1) | keeps host-side buffer logic out of the traced graph | | `apply_routed_scaling_factor_on_output` | AITER path does not implement it | | Batch taller than the buffer, first allocation during graph capture, or config not published | buffer unavailable | ## Accuracy Tests - GSM8K on Kimi-K2.5: **0.935** (earlier head; see the note below). - Re-measured on this head (`0ef769103c`) against its base on `main` (`a99f105294`, no switch exists), with sgl-eval, both arms in parallel on one node: | Build | GSM8K | Truncated | Errors | |---|---:|---:|---:| | this PR (`0ef769103c`) | 96.59% | 0 | 0 | | base `a99f105294` | 96.29% | 0 | 11 (server fault, below) | - Command: `sgl-eval 0.1.3 run gsm8k --num-threads 64 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --thinking --max-tokens 32768` (full 1319; Moonshot's thinking-mode sampling, no sgl-eval preset for K2.5). Within sampling noise (stderr ~0.5 pp). - Server: `amd/Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4`, TP4 per arm, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `--attention-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --reasoning-parser kimi_k2 --max-running-requests 64 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64`. ROCm/aiter stack @ `f9b5308b2`. - The base arm's server died near the end with `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION` (code 0x1016) during long-context graph decode, so its last 11 requests failed. The same fault appears on other K2.5 builds, so it is not from this PR. - Routing results equal the append path exactly, checked with the real AITER kernel. `test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_aiter_topk.py` (CUDA and AMD suites), latest head on MI355X: 10 passed, 41 subtests (also passes merged onto current `main`). - Exact equality with the append path, including `num_expert_group=8, topk_group=4`, `renormalize=False`, `routed_scaling_factor=None`. - CUDA-graph replay, padding, buffer reuse. - Every fallback, reached through real config (EP=2, per-rank slots, env switches, buffer height, unpublished config, radix4, torch-native). ## Speed Tests and Profiling Kimi-K2.5 on MI355X, ROCm/AITER, before vs after: | Concurrency | Total tok/s/GPU before | after | Change | TPOT before (ms) | after (ms) | Change | |---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | 4 | 946.4 | 960.7 | +1.5% | 8.97 | 8.84 | -1.5% | | 8 | 1529.1 | 1545.0 | +1.0% | 11.28 | 11.17 | -1.0% | | 16 | 2135.7 | 2160.2 | +1.2% | 16.11 | 15.83 | -1.7% | | 32 | 2843.6 | 2853.8 | +0.4% | 24.20 | 24.11 | -0.4% | | 64 | 3628.4 | 3690.0 | +1.7% | 37.90 | 37.23 | -1.8% | The profile shows the per-layer append kernel removed. Before: After: - These numbers come from an earlier head on an older `main`, where the AITER path routed in the logits dtype. - Since #44797 an fp32 correction bias routes in fp32 on both paths, so the fused path now feeds AITER fp32 inputs. Speed and GSM8K have not been re-measured on the current head. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #41798097893](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41798097893) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #41798097939](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41798097939) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #41798097887](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41798097887) > [!TIP] > Base CI only covers the core cases, and its workload may not exercise your change. files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,165 @@
+"""ROCm/AITER grouped routing with persistent shared-expert columns.
+
+Each routing config owns a buffer whose shared columns are pre-filled once, so
+layers never alias; AITER writes the routed columns through strided views.
+Batches taller than the buffer keep the append kernel.
+"""
+
+from functools import partial
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import has_per_rank_fused_shared_slots
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import (
+    get_buffer,
+    get_context,
+    get_parallel,
+    get_resources,
+    get_schedule,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location_dispatch import ExpertLocationDispatchInfo
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import StandardTopKOutput, TopKConfig
+
+_MAX_BUFFER_TOKENS = 131072
+_MIN_BUFFER_TOKENS = 8192
+
+
+def _buffer_height() -> int:
+    """Rows per buffer: the prefill token budget, floored for tiny configs and capped."""
+    schedule = get_schedule()
+    budget = max(schedule.chunked_prefill_size or 0, schedule.max_prefill_tokens or 0)
+    if budget <= 0:
+        return _MAX_BUFFER_TOKENS
+    return min(max(budget, _MIN_BUFFER_TOKENS), _MAX_BUFFER_TOKENS)
+
+
+def _allocate_shared_columns(
+    routed_k: int,
+    n_shared: int,
+    num_experts: int,
+    shared_weight: float,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """[height, routed_k + n_shared] weight/id buffers with the shared columns
+    pre-filled (id = num_experts + i, weight = shared_weight)."""
+    height = _buffer_height()
+    total = routed_k + n_shared
+    weights = torch.empty((height, total), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    ids = torch.empty((height, total), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ids[:, routed_k:] = torch.arange(
+        num_experts, num_experts + n_shared, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+    )
+    weights[:, routed_k:] = shared_weight
+    return weights, ids
+
+
+def try_select_experts(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    router_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_config: "TopKConfig",
+    *,
+    layer_id: Optional[int] = None,
+    num_token_non_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    expert_location_dispatch_info: Optional["ExpertLocationDispatchInfo"] = None,
+) -> Optional["StandardTopKOutput"]:
+    """Return fused routing, or None to use the ordinary routing/append path."""
+    config = topk_config
+    n_shared = config.num_shared_topk_slots
+    if (
+        not config.use_grouped_topk
+        or config.correction_bias is None
+        or n_shared <= 0
+        # Standalone callers that never published config keep the ordinary path.
+        or not get_context().is_config_namespace_published("parallel")
+        or get_parallel().moe_ep_size != 1
+        or num_token_non_padded is not None
+        or expert_location_dispatch_info is not None
+        or has_per_rank_fused_shared_slots(n_shared)
+        or envs.SGLANG_SIMULATE_UNIFORM_EXPERTS.get()
+        or envs.SGLANG_SIMULATE_ROUND_ROBIN_EXPERTS.get()
+        or envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_JIT_KERNEL_GROUPED_TOPK.get()
+        # TopK.forward_native (the torch.compile bs=1 route) keeps the ordinary path.
+        or config.torch_native
+        or config.apply_routed_scaling_factor_on_output
+        or config.num_expert_group is None
+        or config.topk_group is None
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    from aiter import biased_grouped_topk
+
+    # Lazy import because the common dispatcher imports this module.
+    from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_distribution import (
+        get_global_expert_distribution_recorder,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import (
+        StandardTopKOutput,
+        aiter_grouped_topk_route_inputs,
+        capture_routed_experts_if_allowed,
+    )
+
+    assert hidden_states.shape[0] == router_logits.shape[0]
+    token, num_experts = router_logits.shape
+    routed_k = config.top_k - n_shared
+    route_inputs = None
+    if envs.SGLANG_K3_RADIX4_TOPK.get():
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.moe import moe_route_radix4
+
+        route_inputs = aiter_grouped_topk_route_inputs(
+            router_logits, config.correction_bias
+        )
+        # The ordinary path routes these shapes with radix4, not AITER.
+        if moe_route_radix4.available() and moe_route_radix4.covered(
+            *route_inputs, routed_k, config.num_expert_group, config.topk_group
+        ):
+            return None
+    shared_weight = config.fused_shared_experts_scaling_factor
+    shared_weight = 1.0 if shared_weight is None else float(shared_weight)
+    device = router_logits.device
+    name = (
+        f"aiter_topk_shared_columns:{id(config)}:{routed_k}:{n_shared}:"
+        f"{num_experts}:{shared_weight}:{device}"
+    )
+    # Allocation must not land inside a graph capture; warmup normally allocates first.
+    if name not in get_resources().buffers and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+        return None
+    full_w, full_ids = get_buffer(
+        name,
+        partial(
+            _allocate_shared_columns,
+            routed_k=routed_k,
+            n_shared=n_shared,
+            num_experts=num_experts,
+            shared_weight=shared_weight,
+            device=device,
+        ),
+    )
+    if token > full_w.shape[0]:
+        return None
+    routed_w = full_w[:token, :routed_k]
+    routed_ids = full_ids[:token, :routed_k]
+    route_logits, route_bias = route_inputs or aiter_grouped_topk_route_inputs(
+        router_logits, config.correction_bias
+    )
+    # AITER honors the output row stride, leaving pre-filled shared columns intact.

+``TestAiterSharedColumnsKernel`` runs the real AITER kernel (ROCm only).
+``TestAiterSharedColumnsContract`` stubs the kernel so the host-side contract
+(eligibility, buffer layout and lifetime, select_experts wiring) runs on every
+GPU runner.

+from sglang.srt.layers.moe import aiter_topk
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe import topk as topk_module

+register_cuda_ci(est_time=10, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+# backend-specific: only ROCm runs the real AITER kernel through the strided
+# shared-column buffer, including CUDA-graph replay.
+register_amd_ci(est_time=15, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd")

+
+def _shared_column_buffers():
+    return {
+        name: buf
+        for name, buf in get_resources().buffers.items()
+        if name.startswith("aiter_topk_shared_columns:")
+    }
+
+
+def _publish(test):
+    """Publish a default config with fresh resources for the test's lifetime."""
+    reset_context()
+    test.addCleanup(reset_context)
+    get_context().override_server_args().install()

+def _full_batch(num_tokens, device):
+    # A non-padded count keeps select_experts on the ordinary routing + append
+    # path while masking no row, which makes it the reference for the fusion.
+    return torch.tensor([num_tokens], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)

+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    torch.cuda.is_available() and _use_aiter,
+    "the real biased_grouped_topk kernel ships with AITER on ROCm",

+class TestAiterSharedColumnsKernel(CustomTestCase):
+    """The fused output must be bit-identical to routing followed by the append."""
+
+    # (num_tokens, num_experts, num_expert_group, topk_group, topk_routed,
+    #  n_shared, routed_scaling_factor, renormalize).
+    CASES = [
+        # Kimi K2.5: 384 routed experts, one group, top-8, one shared.
+        (1, 384, 1, 1, 8, 1, 2.827, True),
+        (37, 384, 1, 1, 8, 1, 2.827, True),
+        (8192, 384, 1, 1, 8, 1, 2.827, True),
+        # DeepSeek-V3 grouped routing: 8 groups, 4 of them kept.
+        (37, 256, 8, 4, 8, 1, 2.5, True),
+        (512, 256, 8, 4, 8, 1, 2.5, False),
+        # A model without a routed scaling factor.
+        (37, 256, 8, 4, 8, 1, None, True),
+    ]
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super().setUp()
+        _publish(self)
+
+    def _inputs(self, num_tokens, num_experts):
+        device = get_device()
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(num_tokens * 31 + num_experts)
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(
+            (num_tokens, 16), generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        ).to(device)
+        router_logits = torch.randn(
+            (num_tokens, num_experts), generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        ).to(device)
+        correction_bias = torch.randn(
+            (num_experts,), generator=g, dtype=torch.float32
+        ).to(device)
+        return hidden_states, router_logits, correction_bias
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _config(bias, groups, topk_group, topk_routed, s, rsf, renormalize, factor):
+        return TopKConfig(
+            top_k=topk_routed + s,
+            use_grouped_topk=True,
+            renormalize=renormalize,
+            num_expert_group=groups,
+            topk_group=topk_group,
+            shared_experts=SharedExpertsConfig(num_fused_shared_experts=s),
+            correction_bias=bias,
+            routed_scaling_factor=rsf,
+            fused_shared_experts_scaling_factor=factor,
+        )
+
+    def test_fused_output_matches_routing_then_append(self):
+        # None and 1 are the two spellings models use for an unscaled shared
+        # expert; both must land on the same weight.
+        for factor in (None, 1, 0.25):
+            for case in self.CASES:
+                num_tokens, num_experts, groups, topk_group = case[:4]
+                with self.subTest(case=case, factor=factor):
+                    hidden, logits, bias = self._inputs(num_tokens, num_experts)
+                    config = self._config(bias, groups, topk_group, *case[4:], factor)
+                    fused = aiter_topk.try_select_experts(hidden, logits, config)
+                    self.assertIsNotNone(fused)
+                    plain = topk_module.select_experts(
+                        hidden,
+                        logits,
+                        config,
+                        num_token_non_padded=_full_batch(num_tokens, logits.device),
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(fused.topk_ids.shape, plain.topk_ids.shape)
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fused.topk_ids, plain.topk_ids))
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fused.topk_weights, plain.topk_weights))
+
+    def test_select_experts_skips_append_and_preserves_padding(self):
+        hidden, logits, bias = self._inputs(37, 384)
+        config = self._config(bias, 1, 1, 8, 1, 2.827, True, 0.25)
+        append_path = "sglang.kernels.ops.moe.fused_moe_triton_kernels.fused_append_shared_experts"
+        with (
+            patch(append_path, wraps=fused_append_shared_experts) as append,
+            patch.object(topk_module, "capture_routed_experts_if_allowed") as capture,
+        ):
+            fused = topk_module.select_experts(hidden, logits, config)
+            append.assert_not_called()
+            # Routed-expert capture sees the routed columns only.
+            self.assertEqual(capture.call_args.args[2].shape[1], 8)
+            expected_ids = fused.topk_ids.clone()
+            expected_w = fused.topk_weights.clone()
+            valid = torch.tensor([17], dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device)
+            padded = topk_module.select_experts(
+                hidden, logits, config, num_token_non_padded=valid
+            )
+            append.assert_called_once()
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(padded.topk_ids[:17], expected_ids[:17]))
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(padded.topk_weights[:17], expected_w[:17]))
+            self.assertEqual(torch.count_nonzero(padded.topk_weights[17:]).item(), 0)
+            append.reset_mock()
+            reused = topk_module.select_experts(hidden, logits, config)
+            append.assert_not_called()
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(reused.topk_ids, expected_ids))
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(reused.topk_weights, expected_w))
+
+    def test_graph_replay_tracks_new_logits(self):
+        hidden, logits, bias = self._inputs(37, 384)
+        config = self._config(bias, 1, 1, 8, 1, 2.827, True, 1)
+        aiter_topk.try_select_experts(hidden, logits, config)
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            out = aiter_topk.try_select_experts(hidden, logits, config)
+        for _ in range(3):
+            logits.normal_()
+            graph.replay()
+            ref = topk_module.select_experts(
+                hidden,
+                logits,
+                config,
+                num_token_non_padded=_full_batch(37, logits.device),
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out.topk_ids, ref.topk_ids))
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out.topk_weights, ref.topk_weights))

+class _FakeAiterBiasedGroupedTopk:
+    """Stand-in for ``aiter.biased_grouped_topk`` with the same call contract.
+
+    The fusion needs only in-place writes that honor the row stride of the
+    views it is handed; ``copy_`` keeps that, so a caller that passed
+    contiguous scratch instead of a view into the buffer would lose its
+    shared columns.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.calls = []
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        gating_output,
+        correction_bias,
+        topk_weights,
+        topk_ids,
+        num_expert_group,
+        topk_group,
+        renormalize,
+        routed_scaling_factor,
+    ):
+        self.calls.append(
+            {
+                "weights_shape": tuple(topk_weights.shape),
+                "weights_row_stride": topk_weights.stride(0),
+                "ids_row_stride": topk_ids.stride(0),
+                "weights_ptr": topk_weights.data_ptr(),
+                "ids_ptr": topk_ids.data_ptr(),
+            }
+        )
+        k = topk_weights.shape[1]
+        scores = gating_output.float() + correction_bias.float()
+        values, indices = torch.topk(scores, k, dim=-1)
+        if renormalize:
+            values = values / values.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        topk_ids.copy_(indices.to(topk_ids.dtype))
+        topk_weights.copy_((values * routed_scaling_factor).to(topk_weights.dtype))
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    torch.cuda.is_available(), "the fusion allocates its buffers on the accelerator"
+)

+            )
+        self.assertIsNone(captured)
+        self.assertEqual(_shared_column_buffers(), {})
+        self.assertIsNotNone(
+            aiter_topk.try_select_experts(hidden_states, router_logits, config)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(len(_shared_column_buffers()), 1)
+
+    def test_select_experts_prefers_the_fusion_on_aiter_builds(self):
+        """``select_experts`` returns the fused output when the fusion applies,
+        and otherwise falls through to the ordinary routing path."""
+        hidden_states, router_logits = self._inputs(37)
+        config = self._config()
+        total = self.TOPK_ROUTED + self.N_SHARED
+        with (
+            patch.object(topk_module, "_is_hip", True),
+            patch.object(topk_module, "_use_aiter", True),
+        ):
+            fused = topk_module.select_experts(hidden_states, router_logits, config)
+            self.assertEqual(len(self.fake_kernel.calls), 1)
+            self.assertEqual(tuple(fused.topk_ids.shape), (37, total))
+
+            # Fall-through: the ordinary routing gate is stubbed because the
+            # real one resolves to aiter symbols that a non-ROCm build never
+            # imported; the shared-expert append after it is backend-neutral.
+            routed = (
+                torch.rand((37, self.TOPK_ROUTED), device=router_logits.device),
+                torch.randint(
+                    0,
+                    self.NUM_EXPERTS,
+                    (37, self.TOPK_ROUTED),
+                    dtype=torch.int32,
+                    device=router_logits.device,
+                ),
+            )
+            with patch.object(topk_module, "biased_grouped_topk", return_value=routed):
+                fallback = topk_module.select_experts(
+                    hidden_states,
+                    router_logits,
+                    config,
+                    num_token_non_padded=_full_batch(37, router_logits.device),
+                )
+            self.assertEqual(len(self.fake_kernel.calls), 1)
+            self.assertEqual(tuple(fallback.topk_ids.shape), (37, total))
+            self.assertTrue(
+                torch.equal(fallback.topk_ids[:, : self.TOPK_ROUTED], routed[1])
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
